name: Donchian 20 channel breakout
description: TREND FOLLOWING. Richard Donchian's channel breakout, and the entry of the Turtle system Dennis and Eckhardt taught in 1983: buy a close above the highest high of the last 20 periods, sell a close below the lowest low. Canonical parameters, declared and not searched: 20 periods is the Turtles' System 1 entry, and the 2N stop below is theirs too, with N their name for the ATR. BORN ON THE DAILY, on commodity and currency futures. The Turtles also exited on a 10-period opposite breakout; here the exit is the library's standard ATR pair, so that this file differs from the others only in its entry.
